SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.title: Girl Form
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.description: Draw from your owned girl deck. Transformation changes form without resetting resources or powers.
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.catDescription: Draw from your owned cat deck. Transformation changes form without resetting resources or powers.
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.smartDescription: Girl and cat form use separate owned card cycles. Transformation preserves resources and powers.

SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.smartDescr: Before your next normal draw, choose {Amount} extra cards from your draw pile to add to hand.

SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.title: Cat Dodge
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.description:
Ready. While in cat form, dodge the first hit of the first enemy multi-hit attack this turn. Single-hit attacks cannot be dodged.
The dodged hit consumes no Block and triggers no Thorns or reflection. Refreshes before your next normal draw; transformation does not refresh it.
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.usedDescription: Used this turn. Cat dodge refreshes before your next normal draw; transformation does not refresh it.
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.smartDescriptio: While in cat form, dodge the first hit of the first enemy multi-hit attack this turn, without consuming Block or triggering retaliation. Refreshes before your next normal draw.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.title: Fluffed Up
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.description:
After activation, the first enemy attack that causes actual HP loss this combat grants 3 Thorns. Each later hit that causes HP loss grants 1.
Each different debuff successfully applied by an enemy grants another 1 Thorns without using the first-hit reward.
The first-hit reward never resets with turns or transformation. Self-damage, poison damage, and status cards do not trigger it.
